# [Title]

## 1. Problem Statement & Industrial/Scientific Reality
(Articulate the exact real-world bottleneck, quantifiable failure metrics, and why current solutions are inadequate)

(Specify the proposed novel technical angle, theoretical foundation, and concrete mechanism)

## 3. Critical Analysis of Prior Work & State of the Art
(Review current benchmarks, citing [S1..Sn] accurately)

## 4. Proposed Experimental Design & Evaluation Protocol
(Define benchmark datasets, baseline models, ablation matrix, and primary evaluation metrics)

## 5. Technical Feasibility, Failure Modes & Edge Cases
(Discuss compute constraints, adversarial vulnerabilities, and operational risks)

## 6. Implementation Milestones
(Outline Phase 1 proof of concept to Phase 4 production validation)

## 7. References & Sources
(List supplied sources with URLs)' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Topic: ' + $json.topic + '
